method: Original public browser game UI. Custom Battle. Human8LightCavalry vs cautiousAI10defenders. C issued with HUD8/8 before contact. Capture uses screenshots with wall-clock timestamps, no audio. No game state introspection.

swordsmen.direction: left to right, frontal through middle of stationary vertical rank

samples_ms.7998: Cavalry has turned into melee; HUD8

spearmen.direction: right to left, frontal through middle of stationary vertical rank

limits: AI F/shield/brace activation is not visible, so these are not proof of explicitly braced defenders.
Different generated maps, opposite approach directions and camera framing; not matched world positions.
Old public build is not latestSteam.
Variable-rate screenshots cannot identify exact first simulation-hit tick or damage timing.
Local footage uses Roman artwork, slanted projection, different cavalry layout and explicit Fflags in shield/pikes fixtures; do not claim equivalence from appearance.
Earlier original-runtime/exploration.mp4 is invalid as an8-rider charge; superseded by these recordings.
design_consequence: Do not invent an unbreakable frontal wall to force old planned acceptance outcome; reproduce measured conditions first.
